Right arm lifts and reaches inward toward the near/image-left backrest edge with fingers open; left arm remains at the opposite side.

Right-hand grip moves the near backrest edge across toward image right, turning the backrest, seat and armrests together to a new swivel angle. Left arm stays on the opposite side and its hand becomes occluded by the backrest.

Right arm lowers to its side; chair remains at the new angle. Left forearm remains behind the backrest; no visible left-hand release is established.
